profiles.validation_note: T2/T4b single-layout evidence is non-monotonic across approximately 1.18-3.50 m. Diagnostic/proximity-only profile retained for historical regression only.

P0c campaign: three Android pairs, five distances (0.5/1/2/3/5 m), both observation directions. Ground truth is validation-only. BLE RSSI remains coarse and environment/orientation sensitive; do not extrapolate outside the validated domain.

policy.advertised_tx_power_semantics: diagnostic transmitter metadata only; never treated as RSSI at 1 m
policy.metric_domain_policy: Outside a validated profile domain, distance_m MUST be null and the sample MUST NOT enter metric geometry. No silent clamp is permitted.
policy.reciprocal_policy: Prefer reciprocal A<->B inverse-variance fusion when both fresh directions are available; otherwise use single-direction metric with conservative sigma.
